endpoint.requirement: Pinned existing billing endpoint or exact explicit override

headers.X-Token: explicit static token; never switch to IAM for static-only API
headers.X-Auth-Token: IAM account only where source supports it

source_operation.description: Returns the estimated time that the remaining balance will last in hours..

request.scope: account only; project/location view rejected before I/O
request.validation: Published provider enum, year2020..2030/month1..12, locale ru/en, date-time offset or source example timezone-free form, transactions limit1..500 and arbitrary-precision nonnegative offset; no defaults added

response.field_mapping: All source fields, recursive report objects and integer/string project IDs retained. Exact Integer quantities; source money->Amount.Raw with unit kopeck, no inferred currency. ProviderTimestamp.Raw retained, UTC only when offset supplied. Names/descriptions/service context/debt reasons protected; optional null preserved with Nullable or formatter-safe OptionalText.
response.resource_ref: none; billing project/object identifiers are billing metadata, never infrastructure adoption refs

errors.over_requested_page_limit: response_limit with retained bounded prefix, no completion claim

retry: bounded safe reads within CallTimeout; no endpoint/credential-scope fallback

wait.availability: unavailable; financial read does not create/wait resources

timeout: CallTimeout and MaxJSONBytes; no unbounded buffering
